frontier.hypothesis: The original compile carried >= 8 references to the walk pointer that existed at flow_analysis time and were gone by global_alloc, and the surviving un-measured mechanism for that is local-alloc.c's optimize_reg_copy_1/2 reference TRANSFER (not combine deletion, which s6 measured at zero yield).
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc.c:781-783 (optimize_reg_copy_1) walks forward from a copy insn `dest = src` whose SRC dies later, replaces every use of SRC between the copy and its death with DEST, and explicitly does `reg_n_refs[sregno] -= loop_depth; reg_n_refs[dregno] += loop_depth` for each replaced use. local-alloc.c:913-914 (optimize_reg_copy_2) does the mirror transfer for the reverse copy shape when DEST dies. Both run inside local_alloc, i.e. AFTER flow (so the transfer is invisible to the byte census) and BEFORE global_alloc (so it changes the priorities the sort sees). This is the only mechanism in the compiler that can ADD references to a pseudo without adding an emitted instruction, and no session has probed it.
frontier.next_probe: Forensics or structural. Instrument or trace optimize_reg_copy_1/2 on this function (BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG already prints the post-transfer nrefs, so a differential is enough: build a chassis containing a copy insn whose source is a reference-rich pseudo and whose destination is the walk pointer, e.g. `s32 *src = D_800A3610 + 5; ... uses of src ...; var_s0 = src;` with src's death after the copy, and read pseudo 73's nrefs off tmp/grind/func_80078654/s5/eval.sh). Establish the per-copy transfer yield first on ONE form; if the transfer moves fewer than 8 references, or if every shape that supplies 8 transferable references materialises extra instructions, this mechanism is dead and the (arg0 >= 13 / walk <= 12) proof obligation becomes unsatisfiable, which is the evidence an escalation entry would need.

frontier.hypothesis: The residual is an artefact of having PATCHED an inherited body rather than re-derived the function: a from-scratch reconstruction of func_80078654 from the target bytes may express the buffer or the walk in a partition no incremental edit of the current body can reach. (Carried forward from s5; still the only untried MODALITY.)
frontier.mechanism: Every form measured in s1-s6 is a local edit of one inherited body. s4 and s5 show that neither 129k random/directed permutations nor hand-built alternative partitions leave that dataflow neighbourhood, and s6 shows the reference counts are fixed by RTL expansion - so only a genuinely different decomposition of the same dataflow can move them. NB s6's proof obligation constrains what a re-derivation must achieve: it must give the walk pointer >= 13 flow-time references while emitting only 5 mentions of $s0.

frontier.mechanism: The kills now cover: reference weighting by loop depth (s1 H3), base/walk merge (s2 H4), every non-priority find_reg route (s2 H5), live-length inflation (s2 H6), sibling census (s2 F2), duplication into arms with cross-jump re-merge (s3 F4), 129k permuter iterations across three chassis and two regimes (s4, s5), index-walk and sub-pointer partitions (s5), post-RA reference creation and reload address reloads (s6), the combine free-reference window (s6), the strictness of the tie-break (s6), and the find_reg pass-0 seeding route (s6).
